neighbours.label: the token just before a named technical concept in physics or maths (negative pressure, Taylor's series, dynamic lift)
fire: The function is expanded in Taylor's series around zero.
The pump creates a negative pressure that draws water upward.
He is best known for his proof of the Pythagorean Theorem.
At speed the hull rises, a phenomenon known as "dynamic lift".
The vent relieves negative pressure in the drain line.
The error is estimated using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
The integral is evaluated by the method of steepest descent.
This effect is explained by the Bernoulli principle.
quiet: The function is written on the board before class.
The pump makes a loud noise that wakes the neighbours.
He is best known for his love of old sports cars.
At speed the boat rocks, and the children laugh loudly.
The vent lets fresh air into the small kitchen.
The error is reported to the manager on Monday.
The integral part of the job is talking to customers.
This effect is visible from the hill in the evening.

notes: No dominant token: ' in' before Taylor's series, opening quote before 'dynamic lift', ' negative' before pressure (x2), ' of' before the Pythagorean Theorem. Guess: anticipating a named technical concept. Near misses are similar prose where the next words are ordinary.
